messages:
ci-bot: ALERT: 1845556666 - warm-pool join failures in prod-eu2 after vpce endpoint-policy rollout. Nodes falling back to NAT egress and hitting STS IpAddress checks; provisioning stalled ~14 nodes.

anya: Noticing keystore traffic to keystore.vault.internal is being denied by the new vpce policy (deny-external-services). Nodes then try privatelink fallback -> NAT -> external, which causes sts:AssumeRole to be denied by IpAddress condition.

sec: Can you paste one example log entry? We need to confirm it's the endpoint policy and not a keystore grant rotation.

anya: From node-agent logs:
```
2026-05-02T02:14:11Z WARN vpce: request to keystore.vault.internal blocked by policy vpce-policy-deny-external
2026-05-02T02:14:12Z ERROR sts:AssumeRole denied role=infra-allocator sourceIP=54.210.12.34 condition:IpAddress
2026-05-02T02:14:12Z ERROR kms:Decrypt AccessDenied grant=none
```

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-20260502-09 created, owner=anya, priority=P1. Auto-ticket links: infra/INC-3911, sec/INC-3912.

michael: Short-term mitigation options: (A) add a narrow vpce policy exception for keystore.vault.internal for prod-eu2 only; (B) add infra-allocator source IP to STS IpAddress allowlist (risky); (C) route warmup to another region (costly). I prefer (A) with TTL.

kevin: +1 for (A). We can scope the exception to the vpce-id and to the keystore service principal, add a 90m TTL tag, and require security approval. That keeps blast radius small.

sec: Approve (A) if we: (1) scope to vpce-id=euc2-keystore; (2) TTL 90m enforced via automation and auto-revoke; (3) write audit entry to s3://secure-audit/vpce-exceptions/ with two-person signoff. No permanent allowlists.

anya: Preparing terraform patch: target=aws_vpc_endpoint_policy_attachment.keystore-exception-prod-eu2. Will include meta tag ttl=90m and run approvals service.

auditor-bot: NOTE: Please include a justification string for compliance capture: "temporary vpce exception to restore GPU warm-pool provisioning due to endpoint-policy collision with keystore service".

ops-bot: Running patch now: `terraform apply -target=aws_vpc_endpoint_policy_attachment.keystore-exception-prod-eu2 -var='env=prod-eu2'` (sanitized).

ci-bot: UPDATE: policy patch applied. Nodes requeued: 14 total, 8 joined, 6 retrying. Monitoring window 2h.

michael: Cost note: fallback to other region would have incurred ~2.2TB/day egress ~ $330/day and increased tail latency; prefer targeted vpce exception. We'll run a small cost analysis PR to add to the runbook.

kevin: Follow-ups: (1) add preflight check in rollout pipeline to detect overlap between vpce deny lists and required keystore endpoints; (2) add unit test that simulates vpce policy deny->nat fallback to ensure we alert earlier; (3) update the STS IpAddress condition to accept privatelink NAT proxies without widening public ranges. I'll open PRs.

sec: After exception created: ensure revoke automation runs and approvals logged. If revoke fails, incident escalates. I'll standby to sign the audit entry.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: warm-pool stabilized; final status 14/14 joined. Exception auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-05-02T04:10:00Z. Will alert on failure.

anya: Thanks. Action items added to INC-3911: kevin=preflight check PR, michael=cost runbook, sec=confirm audit export, ops=monitor revoke. We'll run a short postmortem if this recurs.
